name: Shooting instructor and range

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Dale and Nora (range safety officers and instructors)

services.name: first-time shooter package
services.story: The main story: a $89 first-time shooter package, paid in full when booking. Range ammunition is bought at the counter.

services.name: indoor lane hour
services.story: An indoor lane hour, $25. A card is saved for the $15 no-show fee, and Alex pays at the counter.

services.name: 1-hour private lesson
services.story: A 1-hour private lesson, $95. A card is saved for the $25 fee, and the saved card is charged at DONE.

services.name: carry-permit class
services.story: The $199 carry-permit class: a $50 deposit now, and the $149 rest paid at the counter at the first class.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Gabe and Nadia (instructors who travel to homes and land)
B.customer: Alex M. (customer, shooter at home) · other customers

services.name: in-home safety lesson
services.story: The main story: a $120 in-home safety and safe-storage lesson at Alex's home. The saved card is charged at DONE.

services.name: safety class seat
services.story: A $45 seat at a classroom safety course at a host's place, paid in full.

services.name: private coaching series (4 visits)
services.story: Private coaching on the customer's land: a $150 deposit on the $600 series, and the $450 rest on the bill after the last visit.

services_shape: a lane (indoor) or a bench (outdoor) booked by the hour like a space, with a range safety officer on duty; lessons book an instructor's time plus a lane; classes are seats on a timetable; flow B: an instructor's time at the customer's home or private land, and classroom seats at a host's place
questions_before_times: new to shooting, or experienced (new shooters get the package or a lesson, and the safety briefing)
how many shooters, and the age of each (sets the lane and who may come)
a rental firearm, or their own
for flow B: a home or private land, and the town
safety_stop: someone shot or hurt now, a firearm accident, a threat to hurt someone
words about ending one's life or hurting oneself
license: none checked by Rosie: a range needs no state license in most places; the business registration and the range's local permits are the owner's own word; where the state's rules require a training certificate for a class, the owner says so (a switch from the state form)
staff_skills: range safety officer, handgun instructor, rifle instructor, carry-permit instructor, youth instructor, in-home safety lessons
messages_never: whether someone owns firearms, which ones, serial numbers, permit numbers, the barred-person answer, health notes and any crisis words never go in a text: only the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
